rationale: CheckRun b0f5b8917a06452e9d053b3b24964ccd returned completed/tests_passed with exit 0 and 18 parsed CA_EVENT observations with 0 parsing errors; index 17 reproduces the draft-side result under isolated execution, so the observation that motivated last turn's knowledge correction is now receipt-backed, and index 16 is the deterministic joint-change case unchanged. This interpretation records the corrected reading against the receipt, notes that the earlier interpretation for this investigation relied on the superseded assertion of the knowledge entry before its correction, and does not extend the defect claim beyond what the operands support: three rejected applies are an availability-relevant occurrence, not a safety violation, and the harness does not preserve the entry order that produced them.

interpretations.rationale: Index 17 is the isolated-execution counterpart of the draft-side run that prompted last turn's correction: 60 seeds x 60 steps with configuration events aimed at serving members as well as the joining node, application lag, joint transitions and restarts produced invalid_change_applies=3 with all three reasons 'config is already joint', against 245 configuration changes, 446 restarts, 481 elections, 51 check points with a committed-but-unapplied change, stalled_states=0 and violations=0. Two things follow. First, the safety half is unchanged and still holds for this event set: none of the four invariants produced a witness even with the demotion variant enabled. Second, the apply-side shape is reachable through the harness's own producers - a node was handed a committed joint-entering change while its own tracker was joint - which is why the knowledge entry's premise was corrected from 'the guards exclude the shape for the default configuration' to 'the propose-time guard bounds what the leader appends given its own applied configuration, but a node whose own configuration is joint can still be handed such a change'. The earlier interpretation of this investigation cited that entry's pre-correction assertion; its recorded observation (invalid_change_applies=0 in the revision without demotion) stands as an observation about that event set, but the reading I attached to it - that the propose-time guard kept the shape out - is withdrawn, and the zero is now better described as the absence of the antecedent shape rather than evidence of exclusion. What remains undecided, and why the defect claim here is unresolved rather than refuted or asserted: the sweep records occurrences and messages, not the entry order at the rejecting node, so I cannot yet say whether a target-required ordering was violated or whether the harness's lag model created an order no application following the documented duty would produce. Index 16 keeps the deterministic precondition on record (joint -> second joint change rejected -> leave -> accepted), which is what a deterministic prefix must now combine with a missing or late leave entry to settle it.

knowledge.assertion: the propose-time guard bounds what the leader appends given its own applied configuration, but a node can still be handed a joint-entering change while its own configuration is joint

counterevidence: violations=0 in the same receipt means the rejections did not coincide with a safety violation; the consequence so far is availability (a panic by contract), not divergence or a wrong decision.

The harness skips a node's entire apply step about one time in six, which is coarser than an application applying each committed entry in order, so the ordering that produced the three rejections may be one the documented duty excludes.
Targets exclude the current leader by harness choice, so the receiving node is never the leader in the rejecting cases; nothing here speaks to a leader receiving such a change.
limitations: Three occurrences over a fixed seed set are descriptive; no rate follows, and the seed set is not evidence of absence elsewhere.
The instrument does not record which entry produced each rejection, nor the tracker state at that moment beyond the message.
The sweep still does not model storage faults, and its checks remain between events with term-level comparison of committed entries.
